summary_en: 1,200,000 shares (1.7% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥3,200M maximum expenditure, execution window 7 August 2026 to 31 December 2026. Method: ToSTNeT-3 (立会外) and open-market purchases. Complements three-year dividend policy (FY2026–28) targeting 60–75% total payout ratio (dividends + buyback combined), with annual dividends of ¥65 per share in FY2026 (up from ¥62 in FY2025).
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Public Offer to Purchase Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: AS ONE CORPORATION announced on 7 August 2026 that its board has authorized acquisition of up to 1,200,000 treasury shares (1.7% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥3,200 million during the period from 7 August 2026 to 31 December 2026. The acquisition method will be a combination of ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction) purchases and open-market purchases. The buyback is part of the company's three-year capital allocation policy (FY2026–28) targeting a combined total payout ratio of 60–75% through dividends and share repurchases. The company is implementing annual dividends of ¥65 per share in FY2026 (up from ¥62 in FY2025) and commits to progressive dividend increases throughout the medium-term plan period. The board has the authority under the Companies Act Article 459(1) and the articles of incorporation to determine the timing and scale of buybacks and dividends flexibly, based on share price movements and financial condition. Over the past five years, the company has acquired treasury stock through market purchases and public offers, including a 2022 public offer (1,100,000 shares for ¥5,871M) undertaken in response to a major shareholder's intention to liquidate holdings.
